paragraphs: R' Yudan bar Dorti. See the entry R' Yudan, grandson of R' Shimon bar Yochai.[^1]

notes.text: ב״ב דרש״בי continues the target across the line break, read contextually as “grandson of R' Shimon bar Yochai.” This preserves the current grandson reading rather than a detached fragment. Dorti’s vowels are conventional; the abbreviated personal-title components remain R'.
